2026-09-25ESDCEmployment Insurance ActRegulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations (Pilot Project No. 25)Regulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations (Pilot Project No. 25) in order to (1) waive the one-week waiting period until October 9, 2027; (2) suspend the treatment of monies paid on separation until October 9, 2027; (3) provide an additional 20 weeks of income support to long-tenured workers which applies to claims whose benefit period begins on or after October 11, 2026, but no later than June 12, 2027; and (4) simplify the treatment of rules on reasons for separation for claims whose benefit period begins on or after October 11, 2026, but no later than October 9, 2027.Registration: SOR/2026-0203 Publication Date: 2026-10-07
subject: Regulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations (Pilot Project No. 25)
precis: Regulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations (Pilot Project No. 25) in order to (1) waive the one-week waiting period until October 9, 2027; (2) suspend the treatment of monies paid on separation until October 9, 2027; (3) provide an additional 20 weeks of income support to long-tenured workers which applies to claims whose benefit period begins on or after October 11, 2026, but no later than June 12, 2027; and (4) simplify the treatment of rules on reasons for separation for claims whose benefit period begins on or after October 11, 2026, but no later than October 9, 2027.
